title: Mach-E Thermal System Part 2: A Detailed Comparison to the Model Y
summary: Munro Live's team breaks down the thermal management system of the Ford Mustang Mach-E and compares it with the Tesla Model Y. They look at parts count, coolant loops and heating approaches.
why: Cited as engineering evidence that Tesla's integrated thermal design is far simpler than Ford's, in EV and quality debates.

quote.text: Another fun one is Munro's comparison of the thermal management systems for a Model Y and Ford Mach-E
